fields.title: Every workflow passes actionlint
fields.evidence: The `lint` job's log on the pull request, under the step "Check the workflows".

sections.What it checks:
* [std-CI.GATE](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/4656dba48f651672368cc092d7826758c46976e1/examples/dog-fooding/standards/workflows.md#gate-the-gate-runs-on-every-pull-request-into-main) says a workflow "**MUST** pass `actionlint`, which also puts
  every `run:` block through shellcheck".
sections.How it works: The `lint` job installs actionlint at `v1.7.12` with `go install`, then runs it with no arguments. actionlint reads every file under `.github/workflows/`: the syntax, the expressions and the inputs each action declares. The runner has shellcheck installed, so actionlint passes each `run:` block to it as well. actionlint runs on its own defaults, and this repository has no configuration file for it.
sections.Coverage and gaps:
actionlint reports nothing about whether a workflow is safe to run. [ctl-zizmor](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/4656dba48f651672368cc092d7826758c46976e1/examples/dog-fooding/controls/zizmor.md) runs zizmor in the same job, and checks part of the permission, pinning and checkout rules of [std-CI](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/4656dba48f651672368cc092d7826758c46976e1/examples/dog-fooding/standards/workflows.md). Neither linter checks these faults, and a reviewer catches them:

* a permission a job declares and never uses
* a secret written into a script body, or printed to the log
* a write permission declared on more than one job, or a publish with no verifying job before it

actionlint publishes no manifest Dependabot reads, so the `v1.7.12` pin moves when somebody edits the job.
